name: How does AKN Design Group coordinate design with construction?

mainEntity.name: How does AKN Design Group coordinate design with construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: AKN Design Group employs an integrated design-build process where design planning and construction are unified under one accountable team. Our process begins with detailed consultations and CAD-supported layouts, moving through material selection, permit coordination, and then meticulous construction and installation. This single point of coordination minimizes miscommunication and ensures that the design intent is faithfully executed in the build phase, delivering a managed process from concept to final walkthrough for homeowners in the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex.
acceptedAnswer.description: AKN Design Group unifies design and construction under one team, using CAD-supported planning and continuous communication to ensure design intent is executed during the build phase.
